units.source_text: 我把脚下的一粒小石子踢落在水中。

en.t: I kicked a small stone from beneath my feet into the water.

units.source_text: 激起的水声十分响亮，仿佛把我四周的空气都震得龟裂了。

en.t: The sound of the splashing water was terribly loud, as if it had shaken the air around me until it cracked.

units.source_text: 我将身子缩成一团，纹丝不动，想让这种沉默消去刚才激起的出乎意料的响声。

en.t: I curled my body into a ball and stayed utterly still, hoping that this silence would erase the unexpected sound I had just stirred up.
